name: pixel-8dir-character
title_zh: 八向行走图生成器：一张原图补齐 RPG 全套朝向
tagline_zh: 做俯视角 RPG 或双摇杆射击，最怕角色只会朝下走。给它一张正面图或一句描述。
tagline_en: Top-down games die when characters only face down. Feed it one sprite or a description—get all 8 directions.
desc_en: Create an 8-direction rotation set for a pixel-art character or object (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) from a description, style image, or existing sprite — for top-down RPGs, twin-stick games, and tactics games. Use when the user wants "8 direction character", "rotation frames", "character facing all directions", "8-way sprite", "create rotations", "top-down character directions", or has one sprite
why_zh: 不是简单旋转复制——它理解像素画的轮廓与光影方向，按八向透视重绘，避免斜向帧像纸片翻身。描述、风格图。
why_en: Not naive rotation—it re-draws each frame with correct 8-way perspective and shading, so diagonals don't look like paper.
limit_zh: 只处理像素画角色/物件，不生成场景或 UI。输入须为单帧正面或含清晰朝向的图；复杂机械结构（如履带。
limit_en: Pixel-art characters/objects only—no scenes or UI. Needs one clear front-facing frame or detailed description; complex mechanics (tracks.
title_en: 8-Direction Sprite Generator: Full Rotation Set from One.
